_warning: Default credentials for development only! Change username/password for production!

localhost._listenPort: The local port of the dashboard.
localhost._listenDevice: The IP address of the Network Interface Card (NIC) on which the Dashboard is accessible. `auto` or `internet` queries the device with internet access by pinging to Google's nameserver `8.8.8.8`.

ecos._comment_ip: Replace with your ESU ECoS IP address

z21._comment_ip: Replace with your Roco Z21 IP address
